title: "Case study (population) — profit heatmaps"
author: "Mingze Li"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  github_document: default
---

Heatmaps for the `profit_real` tables produced by [`case_study_population.rmd`](case_study_population.rmd):
**group size** (rows) × **share of trips taken** (columns), colored by mean profit and SD.

Knit `case_study_population.rmd` first (saves `plot/case_study_population_results.rds`).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5, dpi = 300)
RESULTS_RDS <- "plot/case_study_population_results.rds"
```

```{r libraries}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
source("case_study_heatmap.R")
```

```{r load-results}
if (!file.exists(RESULTS_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "Missing ", RESULTS_RDS, ". Knit case_study_population.rmd first."
  )
}
results <- readRDS(RESULTS_RDS)
heatmap_data <- prepare_heatmap_data(results)
heatmap_data
```

```{r mean-heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
plot_profit_mean_heatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  title = "Population model — mean profit"
)
```

```{r sd-heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
plot_profit_sd_heatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  title = "Population model — profit SD"
)
```

```{r combined-heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.8}
plot_profit_combined_heatmap(
  heatmap_data,
  title = "Population model — mean ± SD"
)
```

```{r facet-heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.5}
plot_profit_facet_heatmap(heatmap_data)
```

```{r save-figures, eval=TRUE}
dir.create("plot", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("plot/case_study_population_mean_heatmap.png", width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plot/case_study_population_sd_heatmap.png", plot = plot_profit_sd_heatmap(heatmap_data), width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("plot/case_study_population_combined_heatmap.png", plot = plot_profit_combined_heatmap(heatmap_data), width = 8, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)
```
